entities.name: Jhoira
entities.description: An ancient artificer who raises the Weatherlight and recruits a new crew, aided by a mechanical owl.

entities.name: Hadi
entities.description: Jhoira's Tolarian assistant artificer.

entities.name: Tien
entities.description: The chief metalworker of Jhoira's salvage crew.

entities.name: Ziva
entities.description: A Vodalian merfolk who raised the wreck.

entities.name: Tiana
entities.description: An angel sent by the Church of Serra who feels an affinity for the Weatherlight and revives its Powerstone.

entities.name: Shanna Sisay
entities.description: A descendant of Captain Sisay who is immune to magic and joins the Weatherlight's crew.

entities.name: Captain Sisay
entities.description: The original Weatherlight captain, Shanna's ancestor, whom Jhoira knew.

entities.name: Gerrard Capashen
entities.description: A famous past Weatherlight captain, ancestor of the Capashens.

entities.name: Danitha Capashen
entities.description: A knight of Benalia and Capashen who declines to join, preferring to defend her home.

entities.name: Raff Capashen
entities.description: Danitha's young brother, an illusionist mage who talks his way onto the crew.

entities.name: Arvad
entities.description: A vampire dressed as a knight of Benalia who swears to serve Jhoira.

entities.name: Ajani Goldmane
entities.description: A planeswalker who arrives in a rush of golden light, the friend Jhoira expected.

entities.name: Jodah
entities.description: A figure from before the Phyrexian invasion whose name Raff misuses.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: A figure whose whereabouts Jhoira knows, a possible crew member.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: A former companion Jhoira misses.

entities.name: Venser
entities.description: A former companion Jhoira misses.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: The creator of the Powerstone who cast the spell that ended the Phyrexian invasion.

entities.name: Molimo
entities.description: A tree elemental who gave Jhoira a hull seed.

entities.name: Belzenlok
entities.description: The demon who wants to rewrite history with himself behind every act of darkness.

entities.name: The Cabal
entities.description: A death cult attacking merchants and towns across Dominaria.

entities.name: Church of Serra
entities.description: The church that sent Tiana to oversee the Powerstone.

entities.name: Sarin Mercantile
entities.description: A merchant house whose treasury in Suq'Ata was infiltrated.

entities.name: Weatherlight
entities.description: The famed Thran skyship, raised from the sea and rebuilt.

entities.name: Powerstone
entities.description: A teardrop crystal in the Weatherlight's engine made by Urza, containing Serra's Realm.

entities.name: Bogardan
entities.description: The volcanic coast where the Weatherlight is restored.

entities.name: Suq'Ata
entities.description: A Jamuraan market city where Jhoira finds Shanna.

entities.name: Benalia City
entities.description: The Benalish city with the Capashen townhouse.

entities.name: Jamuraa
entities.description: The continent of Suq'Ata.

entities.name: Aerona
entities.description: The island on the way to Benalia City.

entities.name: Phyrexian invasion
entities.description: A past war ended by Urza's final spell.

events.summary: Jhoira views the raised wreck of the Weatherlight on a Bogardan beach.
events.quote: Jhoira stood on the shore looking at what was left of the great skyship

events.summary: Tiana is moved by the Weatherlight's skeleton, recognizing it as Gerrard's blade.
events.quote: It's Gerrard's blade in the portraits.

events.summary: Jhoira notices Tiana crying and suspects her reaction is tied to the ship.
events.quote: Why are you crying?

events.summary: The salvagers prepare a hull seed from Molimo and examine the Powerstone.
events.quote: a new hull seed Jhoira had obtained from the tree elemental Molimo

events.summary: Tiana revives the inert Powerstone.
events.quote: Jhoira felt the shift in the Powerstone, the moment when it came to life again.

events.summary: Jhoira asks Tiana to oversee the reconstruction while she gathers a crew, and Tiana agrees.
events.quote: No, I need someone to supervise the reconstruction and protect the workers while I gather a crew.

events.summary: Jhoira sails to Suq'Ata to find a potential crew member.
events.quote: she took her barque to the coast of Jamuraa first, to the city of Suq'Ata

events.summary: A panicked man reports a Cabal spy in the treasury of the Sarin Mercantile.
events.quote: A Cabal spy in the treasury of the Sarin Mercantile!

events.summary: Jhoira watches through her owl as a swordswoman fights Cabal agents on a warehouse roof.
events.quote: one woman with a sword fought half a dozen men wearing the concealing robes of desert nomads.

events.summary: Jhoira recognizes the woman's immunity to magic.
events.quote: It was an immunity to magic, and she had seen it before.

events.summary: Shanna explains the Cabal agents wanted route maps to attack merchants.
events.quote: Cabal agents, trying to get the merchants' route maps

events.summary: Jhoira reveals she knew Shanna's ancestor Captain Sisay.
events.quote: I knew your ancestor, Captain Sisay. I see you carry her sword.

events.summary: Jhoira introduces herself to Shanna.
events.quote: I'm Jhoira. I came here to find you.

events.summary: Shanna agrees to serve on the Weatherlight.
events.quote: Then I would consider it an honor to have you on my crew.

events.summary: Danitha Capashen refuses to join, bound to defend Benalia.
events.quote: I'm sworn to defend this land.

events.summary: Raff Capashen volunteers to go in his sister's place.
events.quote: I'm a Capashen. I'm Raff.

events.summary: Jhoira exposes Raff's lie about Jodah.
events.quote: Jodah did not say that.

events.summary: Raff shows his skill by creating an illusion of the original Weatherlight.
events.quote: In the distance the original version of the Weatherlight angled across the sky.

events.summary: Jhoira recruits Raff.
events.quote: If you want to come, pack hurriedly.

events.summary: The Weatherlight is restored and ready to launch.
events.quote: The Weatherlight was whole and ready to launch.

events.summary: Raff notices a vampire waiting with Tiana.
events.quote: Why does she have a vampire with her?

events.summary: The vampire Arvad swears to serve Jhoira.
events.quote: I swear to serve at your side, Captain Jhoira.

events.summary: Ajani Goldmane arrives, the friend Jhoira was waiting for.
events.quote: With a rush of wind and golden light, Ajani Goldmane appeared on the shore.

relations.quote: The demon Belzenlok wants to rewrite the history of the world
